rows.quote: We believe that our domestic competition does not provide the same level of custom coatings to the industry as our Architectural Glass segment, but regional glass fabricators can provide somewhat similar products with similar attributes.
rows.note: 原本自身が『地域のガラス加工業者が同等品を供給できる』と述べ、さらに『increased competition from these regional glass fabricators』と続く。顧客側の再認定の記述は certification/specification パターンを走査しても皆無で、出る specification は『customer specifications に合わせて設計する』＝当社が顧客仕様に合わせる側。

rows.quote: The company operates in a highly competitive environment, both in the United States and internationally.
rows.note: 電子部品ディストリビュータ。『There is significant competition within each market sector and geography served that creates pricing pressure』と価格競争を自認し、競争要因も納期・在庫・与信の並列列挙。certification の語は自社が VAR へ提供する研修認定と SOX 宣誓書のみで、顧客側の再認定は無い。

rows.quote: This industry segment faces strong competition in price, service and product performance and competes with both large publicly-held companies and various smaller manufacturers.
rows.note: 3セグメント全てで『strong competition in price』を自認し競合を実名列挙。『the only company offering a single source for a complete pellet plant』という唯一供給めいた記述はあるが、直後に『known competitors only sell individual plant components』＝部品単位では複数供給者が存在するので100には当たらない。ISO9001/CE は自社取得の認証で85の対象外。

rows.quote: The sale of automotive parts, accessories and maintenance items is highly competitive in many areas, including name recognition, product availability, customer service, store location and price.
rows.note: 競合として全国・地域・独立店・オンライン・量販・ホームセンター等を広範に列挙し、競争軸は価格と利便性。原本に顧客側の再認定・移行障壁の記述は一切無い（certification は従業員のASE資格＝自社側）。主観の堀は店舗密度・ハブ配送・Duralast等のPBで強いと見るが、irrの機構とは別物。

rows.quote: We face strong competition from traditional store-based retailers, multi-channel retailers, internet-based businesses, our vendors and other forms of retail commerce, which directly affects our sales and margins. The retail business is highly competitive.
rows.note: 小売で顧客の乗換コストはゼロ。原本自ら『Price is of primary importance』と述べ、仕入先自身が直販に回る脅威まで挙げる。『structural barriers to entry』の語は大型家電・モバイルという*カテゴリ*の説明で、顧客側の負担は書かれていない一般論。

rows.quote: Strong competition exists in each of Brunswick's product groups, but no single enterprise competes with Brunswick in all product groups.
rows.note: 船外機はボートビルダーへ供給されるがロックは無い——原本自ら『can lead them to purchase marine engines and marine engine supplies from competing marine engine manufacturers』と乗換を明記。EPA排ガス規制は当社が満たす側の基準で、顧客の再認定ではない。

rows.quote: We compete in industries that are subject to significant competition and pricing pressures in most markets.
rows.note: 現金輸送。G4S/Loomis/Prosegur/Garda を実名で挙げ価格圧力を自認。警備契約は『Generally, guarding contracts are for a one-year period』＝1年更新で、長期認定でも乗換障壁でもない。原本が挙げる固定費（装甲車隊・支店網）は当社側の負担であって顧客側の再認定ではない。

rows.quote: Some products are manufactured to meet published industry specifications and are less differentiated on the basis of product characteristics.
rows.note: ケーブル・接続。公表された業界規格に合わせて作る＝規格が当社を縛る側で、顧客が当社仕様を認定する側ではない。さらに『In general, our customers are not contractually obligated to buy our products exclusively, in minimum amounts, or for a significant period of time』。OEM向け設計組込を思わせる記述はあるが再認定の断定は無い。

rows.quote: Competition in the biopharmaceutical industries is intense and comes from many sources, including specialized biotechnology firms and large pharmaceutical companies. Many of our competitors are working to develop products similar to those we are developing or already market and have considerable experience in undertaking clinical trials and in obtaining regulatory approval to market pharmaceutical products.
rows.note: 原本が述べる防御はすべて自社が取得する側——特許・Hatch-Waxmanの存続期間延長・regulatory exclusivity・SPC。規約が85から明示除外する型。処方医が乗り換えられない、という顧客側負担の記述は switch/physicians を走査しても無く、逆に generics/biosimilars による代替リスクを自認。主観の堀は特許とMSフランチャイズで強い。

rows.quote: The senior living industry is highly competitive.
rows.note: 原本自身が『barriers to competitive entry in the retirement center and assisted living sectors of the senior living industry are not substantial』と参入障壁の低さを明言し、在宅介護・コミュニティ事業・リタイアメント施設等の代替を列挙。certification は州の免許・Medicare認定＝当社が取得・維持する側で85に当たらない。

rows.quote: The market for the travel reservation services we offer is intensely competitive, and current and new competitors can launch new services at a relatively low cost.
rows.note: 消費者もホテルも乗換費用ゼロ。原本は Google/Apple/Alibaba/Amazon/Facebook の参入と Expedia系の実名列挙、さらに『consumers may not be willing to download multiple apps』とアプリ側の争奪を語る。顧客が当社を認定する機構は一切無い。主観の堀（規模・在庫網・広告効率）は強いが irr の型ではない。

rows.quote: The building products supply industry is highly fragmented and competitive. We face significant competition from local and regional building materials chains, as well as from privately-owned single site enterprises.
rows.note: fragmented を二度自認（Business節でも『the highly fragmented nature of the Pro Segment』）。競争手段は『long-term relationships』『trade credit, competitive pricing』＝関係と与信であって認定ではない。マスターファイル（各ビルダーの設計を電子保管）という統合はあるが、顧客側の再認定の記述は無い。

rows.quote: Additionally, the Company faces significant price competition as competitors reduce their selling prices and attempt to imitate the Company’s product features and applications within their own products or, alternatively, collaborate with each other to offer solutions that are more competitive than those they currently offer.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K(filed 2014-10-27)。顧客側の再認定の記述はゼロ。'certification'の唯一の実体は「当社の端末が政府機関・標準化団体・通信キャリアの認証を受ける」＝自社が取得する側で向きが逆。自ら『minority market share in the smartphone market』と価格競争・模倣を述べる。

rows.quote: The low cost of entry in the facility solutions business results in a very competitive market. We experience competition from a large number of mostly regional and local owner-operated companies that may have better visibility to local markets and lower labor and overhead costs, which can provide them with a competitive advantage.
rows.note: FY2014(10/31期)10-K。会社自身が参入コストの低さと多数の地場競合を明記。売上の大半が competitive bids。qualification/certificationのヒットは全て集団訴訟のクラス認定と年金の actuary 認証で堀と無関係。

rows.quote: We operate in highly competitive business environment which presents a number of challenges, including: • low barriers to entry; • sophisticated and large customers who have the ability to source their own private label products; • limited retail space which constrains our ability to offer certain products; • competitors with strong brands;
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。『low barriers to entry』を自ら列挙し、顧客(量販)がPB内製できると述べる。タブレット周辺品の commoditization も自認。移行障壁の記述は一つも無い。

rows.quote: We consider our business to be highly competitive. In addition, our markets present few economic or technological barriers to entry, contributing to a high fragmentation of market share.
rows.note: FY2014(6/30期)10-K。fragmented を会社自身が明言。堀として挙げるのは longstanding relationships・地理的網・人の知識＝組織であって顧客側の移行障壁ではない。最大顧客が売上の3%未満。

rows.quote: Within the end-use markets in which we compete, competition between products is intense. Substitute products also exist for many of our products.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。両セグメントとも『which qualified supplier is awarded a contract』＝認定済み供給者が価格・条件で競う構図で、認定は存在しても価格支配力を与えていない。顧客が代替品へ switch する risk も自認。対抗材料として『Commencement of production requires start-up, commission and certification of product quality by our customers』はあるが、当社の新設備の立上げ遅延リスクの文脈で、顧客が他社へ替える際の負担としては述べていないため85には採らず。

rows.quote: In order to provide Invisalign treatment to their patients, orthodontists and GPs must initially complete an Invisalign training course.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。顧客(歯科医)側に訓練履修という先行投資を課す＝移行摩擦は実在するが、他社へ替える際の再認定・データ再生成の断定は無いので70止まり。ISO13485・各国当局の認証は全て自社が取得する側。single sourceのヒットは自社の調達側で向きが逆。352件の米国特許・ブランドは堀の主体だがirrの刻みには乗らない。

rows.quote: There are other companies developing extended-release product platforms. In many cases, there are products on the market or in development that may be in direct competition with our marketed products or product candidates.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。徐放プラットフォームの競合が複数存在し、後発・新規化合物の脅威を自認。パートナー向け受託製造をするがパートナー側の再認定・技術移管コストの記述は走査しても無し(alternative manufacturer/technology transfer/site changeで走査)。certificationのヒットはANDAのParagraph IV認証＝特許制度の話。

rows.quote: Our industry is highly competitive, with many companies of varying size and business models, many of which have their own proprietary technologies, competing for the same business as we do.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。州がESCOを pre-qualify する制度は存在するが『the Commonwealth of Massachusetts and the states of Colorado and Washington pre-qualify energy service providers』＝当社が取得する側の政府調達資格で規約の除外対象。案件は入札・価格圧力。

rows.quote: All of our products face substantial competition. There exist major worldwide competing products, made from HA and other materials, for use in orthopedics, surgical adhesion prevention, advanced wound care, ENT, cosmetic dermatology, and ophthalmic surgery.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。HA製品・他素材製品の競合が全製品ラインに存在すると自認。CE Mark・FDA承認は自社が取得する側。GPOの交渉力増大と価格譲歩リスクも記載。顧客側の再認定の記述なし。

rows.quote: Our asset retirement obligations are primarily associated with Tonnage Gases on-site long-term supply contracts, under which we have built a facility on land owned by the customer and are obligated to remove the facility at the end of the contract term.
rows.note: FY2014(9/30期)10-K。トン数ガスは顧客の敷地内に当社が設備を建て『initial contract terms of 15 to 20 years』で供給＝物理的な深い統合と長期契約。ただし顧客側の再認定の断定は無く、Merchant Gases(売上41%)は『Competition in industrial gases is based primarily on price, reliability of supply』と価格競争を自認するので85には届かない。

rows.quote: Within the postsecondary education market, APUS competes primarily with not-for-profit public and private two-year and four-year colleges as well as other for-profit schools, particularly those that offer online learning programs.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。軍関係市場で競合が拡大し学生獲得コストが上昇と自認。Title IV の ED 認証・地域アクレディテーションは全て自社が取得する側で規約の除外対象。学生(顧客)側の移行障壁の記述なし。PAD特許はあるがirrの刻みには乗らない。

rows.quote: Direct costs that are incurred to set up or convert a client’s systems to function with the Company’s technology are generally deferred and recognized on a straight-line basis which commences after client acceptance when the processing term begins.
rows.note: 顧客システムの変換を要する深い統合＝高摩擦（closed salesが収益化まで12〜24ヶ月とも記述）。ただし変換費用を負うのは当社側で、顧客側の再認定の断定は無く、同10-Kは『clients have the opportunity to renegotiate their contracts…or engage one of our competitors』とも書く→85には届かず70。

rows.quote: The production, processing, and distribution of shell eggs is an intensely competitive business, which traditionally has attracted large numbers of producers. Shell egg competition is generally based on price, service, and product quality. The U.S. shell egg industry remains highly fragmented
rows.note: 原本自身が fragmented・多数の生産者・価格競争と明記。特許も専有技術も無い（『We do not own any patents or proprietary technologies』）。

rows.quote: Listed options on equities and ETPs currently may be listed on all options exchanges, while trading in our proprietary products is limited to our exchanges.
rows.note: SPX/OEX/DJIAの独占上場ライセンスを既に保有し、自社商品は他取引所で取引できないと原本が明言＝その用途で他に供給者が存在しない（取引手数料の81.8%が該当）。留保: 独占は所有でなく2032/33年までのライセンスで、multiply-listed部分は激しい価格競争。

rows.quote: the prices of our most significant products are typically regional or world market prices
rows.note: 最大セグメントAcetyl Intermediates（2014年売上2,961百万$＝約44%）は世界市況価格の汎用品で各セグメントに競合を10社以上名指し。engineered materials（1,459百万$＝21%）だけは『A significant portion of our engineered materials products are specified by customers』＝設計組込型70相当だが全社では少数派なので50。

rows.quote: Most fertilizers are global commodities, with little or no product differentiation, and customers make their purchasing decisions principally on the basis of delivered price and to a lesser extent on customer service and product quality.
rows.note: 原本が『little or no product differentiation』『limited barriers to entry』と自認。北米天然ガスのコスト優位はあるが移行障壁ではない。

rows.quote: Consumer products, particularly laundry and household cleaning products, as well as certain toothpaste products, are subject to significant price competition. As a result, the Company from time to time may need to reduce the prices for some of its products to respond to competitive and customer pressures and to maintain market share
rows.note: ブランドはあるが原本は値下げ圧力と小売の力を明記。認証・組込・切替費用の記述は走査したが皆無。

rows.quote: The market for information and network security solutions is intensely competitive and we expect that competition will continue to increase in the future. Our competitors include Cisco Systems, Inc., Juniper Networks, Inc., Fortinet Inc., SonicWall Inc. (owned by Dell Inc.), Palo Alto Networks, Inc., WatchGuard Technologies, Inc., McAfee, Inc. (owned by Intel Corporation), Sourcefire, Inc. (owned by Cisco Systems Inc.), and other companies in the network security space.
rows.note: 20-F全文で switching / migration / installed base の語がゼロ（switch 0件・migrat 0件）。維持契約の更新収入は大きいが移行障壁の記述は無く、競合多数名指し＋価格圧力の自認のみ。

rows.quote: We face competition for both residential and commercial customers in the areas of price, service offerings, and service reliability.
rows.note: フランチャイズは非独占（『Cable systems are operated under non-exclusive franchises…More than one cable system may legally be built in the same area』）、DBS・電話会社・無線と代替多数。設備の局地的優位はあるが原本は移行障壁を述べない。

rows.quote: Competition in steelmaking raw materials is predicated upon the usual competitive factors of price, availability of supply, product quality and performance, service and transportation cost to the consumer of the raw materials.
rows.note: BHP/Rio/Vale等と価格・輸送コストで競う汎用原料。長期契約と顧客集中はあるが顧客側の再認定・認定業者名簿の記述は無い。

rows.quote: We compete primarily on the services we provide to our customers and on the price and quality of our products.
rows.note: 鉄スクラップ・鉄筋の汎用品。各セグメントとも価格・品質・納期での競争を原本が明記し、認証や組込の記述は皆無。

rows.quote: The material handling industry remains highly fragmented. We face competition from a wide range of regional, national and international manufacturers globally.
rows.note: 原本が fragmented と明記。certification の語は多数出るが全て**当社が販売店・エンドユーザーに提供する研修/認定プログラム**（向きが逆＝顧客が当社を認定するのではない）。

rows.quote: All of our businesses operate in intensely competitive, consumer-driven and rapidly changing environments and compete with a growing number of companies that provide a broad range of communications products and services and entertainment, news and information products and services to consumers.
rows.note: 規模・設備・コンテンツ資産は厚いが、irrの観点では原本が全事業で激しい競争と技術変化を自認し、DBS・光ファイバー（自社エリアの約55%と重複）・無線が代替。顧客側の認定や移行費用の記述は無い。

rows.quote: the substitution of our clearing houses as the counterparty to every transaction allows our customers to establish a position with one party and offset the position with another party. This contract offsetting process provides our customers with flexibility in establishing and adjusting positions and provides for collateral and margining efficiencies.
rows.note: 10-K(2015-02-26/FY2014)。堀は流動性と垂直統合クリアリング（建玉の相殺・証拠金効率が自社の中で閉じる）＝構造的な移行摩擦で70。顧客側の再認定の記述は皆無で、自社は 'The industry in which we operate is highly competitive' と自認。引用は認定の話ではないので tense は なし。

rows.quote: Highway deicing salt in North America is sold primarily through an annual tendered bid contract process with governmental entities, as well as through some longer-term contracts, with price, product quality and delivery capabilities as the primary competitive market factors.
rows.note: 10-K(2015-02-23/FY2014)。毎年の入札で価格が主因子＝代替容易で50。'We face strong competition in each of the markets in which we operate' とも自認。堀は鉱山の立地と輸送費（moat5は3）だが顧客側の移行障壁の記述は無い。

rows.quote: In the institutional channel, we compete against a large pool of investment managers offering similar products and services, from boutique establishments to major commercial and investment banks. Performance, price and brand are the principal factors of competition.
rows.note: 10-K(2015-02-27/FY2014)。'a large pool of investment managers offering similar products and services'＝同等品の多数供給を自認し、競争因子は運用成績・価格・ブランド。qualification/certification の語は SOX 302 の署名以外に一つも無い。

rows.quote: We face and will continue to face significant price competition. Generally, pricing is very aggressive in our industry, and we expect pricing pressures to escalate should economic conditions deteriorate.
rows.note: 10-K(2015-03-06/FY2014)。IT製品の再販で 'The direct marketing and sale of IT related products, is highly competitive'・CDW/Insight等の大手と価格競争を自認＝50。技術者の資格取得は自社側の認証で規約の除外対象。

10-K(2015-03-02/FY2014)。8事業を持つ持株会社で刻みが散る（Arnoldは顧客の設計への6-18ヶ月の共同開発・認定過程が『barriers to customers changing solution providers』と70〜85型／一方 Tridien・Ergobaby は市場を fragmented と明記＝50）。全社ベースの刻みが確定できないため空欄（domの規約(1)の類推）。

rows.quote: Our sales force includes a highly-trained team of application engineers to assist customers in designing, testing and qualifying our parts as key components of our customers’ systems.
rows.note: 読解対象は readlist が解決した CIK 820318＝II-VI Incorporated の 10-K(2014-08-28/FY2014)で、ティッカーCOHRの現在の実体（Coherent Corp）に対応。qualif は当社が顧客を『assist』する願望形のみで顧客側の再認定の断定が無く70。

rows.quote: We face significant competition from other remarketers of both salvage and non-salvage vehicles. We believe our principal competitors include vehicle auction and sales companies and vehicle dismantlers. These national, regional and local competitors may have established relationships with vehicle sellers and buyers and may have financial resources that are greater than ours.
rows.note: 10-K(2014-09-29/FY2014)。堀は全国ヤード網と両面オークション（州外購入51.3%）でmoat5=4だが、原本の移行障壁の記述は『salvage management tools that help sellers integrate their systems with ours』を今後提供するという願望形のみ。競合が保険会社から直接買って remarketer を迂回しうるとも書く＝50。

rows.quote: We believe that the barriers to entry in a majority of our business units are generally high and present a significant impediment for new market participants, particularly in those areas which require substantial capital expenditures, trained and specialized personnel, and mandate GLP-compliant practices.
rows.note: 10-K(2015-02-17/FY2014)。GLP設備・専門人材の参入障壁と preferred provider/strategic partnership が売上の25%超、顧客の遺伝子改変コロニーを預かる深い統合＝70。ただし引用は参入障壁の一般論で顧客側の再認定の断定は無く（規約の85除外）、GLP適合は自社取得側。

rows.quote: A majority of our contracts can be terminated by our clients with short notice and without significant early termination cost.
rows.note: 10-K(2015-02-27/FY2014)。会社自身が『解約コスト無しで短期解約できる』と明記＝スイッチングコストの不在の直接証拠。'intensely competitive'・価格下押し圧力も自認で50。

rows.quote: Our principal method of competition is production of quality products at competitive prices delivered in a timely and efficient manner.
rows.note: 読解対象は CIK 25445＝Crane Co. の 10-K(2015-02-25/FY2014)。全社の競争手段を品質と『competitive prices』と自認し 'all of our markets are highly competitive'＝50。航空segment（売上約24%）だけは 'custom designed to the requirements and specifications of the aircraft manufacturer' の設計組込型だが、顧客側の再認定・FAA認定の記述は無い。

rows.quote: The wholesale distribution industry is highly competitive. There are many distribution companies operating in the same geographical regions as our Company. Our Company's principal competitors are national and regional wholesalers, along with a host of smaller grocery and tobacco wholesalers.
rows.note: 10-K(2014-11-07/FY2014)。たばこ・食品の卸売と自然食小売。競合が『prices comparable to those offered by our Company』で同等品を供給と自認＝50。認定・移行障壁の記述は皆無。

rows.quote: We expect the intensity of competition to increase in the future from other established and emerging companies due to the relatively low barriers to entry for the services we offer, as well as small businesses' increasing use of the internet which allows service providers to work directly with small businesses as opposed to using intermediaries.
rows.note: 10-K(2015-02-20/FY2014)。会社自身が『relatively low barriers to entry』・市場は『highly fragmented』と述べる＝50。金融機関との小切手供給契約は3-6年（20%は7年超）だが契約期間であって顧客側の再認定ではない。

rows.quote: Competition in the regulated electric distribution business is primarily from the on-site generation of industrial customers and from distributed generation applications by industrial and commercial customers. We do not expect significant competition for distribution to any group of customers in the near term.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K(2015-02-13)。規制下の配電は実質競合なしと自ら述べるが「唯一供給」の断定はなく、供給側はCustomer Choiceで既に約10%が代替供給者へ移行済（『customers with retail access to alternative electric suppliers represented approximately 10% of retail sales』）。顧客側の再認定の記述はゼロ＝85には当たらない。

rows.quote: Regulated Utilities’ businesses operate as the sole supplier of electricity within their service territories, with the exception of Ohio, which has a competitive electricity supply market for generation service.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K(2015-03-02)のCompetition節。当該用途・当該territoryで他に供給者が存在しないと原本が明言＝100の定義そのもの。ただし機構は規制フランチャイズであり工程認定型ではないのでmechはなし。Ohioの発電供給は例外と自認。

rows.quote: We compete directly with Sony and Microsoft, each of which develops and publishes software for its respective console platform. We also compete with numerous companies which, like us, develop and publish video games that operate on these consoles and on PCs. These competitors include Activision Blizzard, Take-Two Interactive, and Ubisoft.
rows.note: FY2015(3月期)10-K(2015-05-21)。競合を多数名指しし、モバイルは『frequent product introductions』『we expect competition ... to continue to intensify』。qualif/certif/switching costの堀記述は全文走査でゼロ。

rows.quote: Moreover, the barriers to entry into these channels can be low, and businesses easily can launch online sites or mobile platforms and applications at nominal cost by using commercially available software or partnering with any of a number of successful ecommerce companies.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K(2015-02-06)。原本自身が参入障壁の低さを明言（Enterprise側も『Low barriers to entry』）。顧客側の再認定・移行費用の記述なし。moat5はマーケットプレイス／PayPalの網の効果に対する主観でirrとは独立に4。

rows.quote: BioThrax is the only vaccine licensed by the FDA for the prevention of anthrax disease.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K(2015-03-06)。当該用途で他に供給者が存在しないと断定（BAT『the only heptavalent therapeutic licensed by the FDA』、VIGIV『the only therapeutic licensed by the FDA』、RSDL『the only medical device licensed by the FDA』と同型が4製品）。規制当局が用途ごとに認定する型＝mech C。ただし同節は『we face potential future competition for the supply of anthrax vaccines to the U.S. government』とも記す。

rows.quote: The set-top box industry is highly competitive, and market leadership changes frequently as a result of new products, designs and pricing.
rows.note: ※銘柄対応の注意: readlistのECHOはCIK 1415404＝EchoStar Corporationの10-K(2015-02-20)で、Echo Global Logisticsではない。読んだのはEchoStar。競合をArris/Cisco/PACE/Samsung/Technicolorと名指しし『highly competitive』、Hughes側も『The network communications industry is highly competitive』。顧客側の再認定記述なし。

rows.quote: The consumer credit recovery industry is highly competitive and fragmented. We compete with a wide range of collection and financial services companies.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K(2015-02-26)。原本が明示的にfragmented＋『Barriers to entry into the consumer debt collection industry have traditionally been low』。落札は主に価格（『successful bids are predominantly awarded based on price』）＝代替容易。

rows.quote: The Utilities do not consider it reasonably likely that another company would be authorized to provide utility delivery service of electricity, natural gas or steam where the company already provides service.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K(2015-02-19)のCompetition節。同一地域で他社が配送サービスを提供する可能性を原本が否定し、参入にはNYSPSC認可・設備新設・料金同等負担が要ると列挙＝当該用途に他の供給者が存在しない旨の記述。機構は規制フランチャイズなのでmechはなし。

rows.quote: The market for our products and services is highly competitive and is subject to constant change. Our competitors vary widely in size and the nature of the products and services they offer.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K(2015-02-25)。Competition節は『two global consumer credit reporting companies, Experian Group and TransUnion LLC, both of which offer a product suite similar』＝同等品の供給者が実在。switching cost・深い統合・顧客側再認定を探したが記述なし（あるのは『access to unique proprietary databases』という競争要因の列挙のみ）。データ資産の主観的な強さはmoat5=4で別に記録。

rows.quote: We sell most of our products in highly fragmented and competitive markets.
rows.note: readlistのENOVはCIK 1420800＝当時のColfax Corporationの10-K(2015-02-17)。ガス・流体handlingも『highly fragmented and competitive』。海軍向けspecialty valveはあるが記述は『enable us to serve as a supplier to the U.S. Navy』までで、承認業者名簿・顧客側の再認定・sole sourceの断定は全文走査でゼロ。

rows.quote: The skilled nursing industry is highly competitive, and we expect that the industry will become increasingly competitive in the future. The industry is highly fragmented and characterized by numerous local and regional providers, in addition to large national providers.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K(2015-02-09)。原本が明示的にfragmented。在宅・ホスピスは『There are few barriers to entry』とも自認。Medicare certificationは当社が取得する側＝85の除外項に該当（certificate of needも規制であり顧客側の再認定ではない）。

rows.quote: Competition in the oil and gas exploration and production industry is intense, and many of our competitors have greater resources than we have. We compete with major integrated oil and gas companies, government-affiliated oil and gas companies and other independent oil and gas companies.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K(2015-02-18)。競争はリース・設備の取得を巡るもので、産出物は代替可能なコモディティ。qualification/certification/switching costの堀記述は全文走査でゼロ（ヒットはSOX証明書の一覧のみ）。

rows.quote: The market for power generation equipment and other engine powered products is competitive. We face competition from a variety of large diversified industrial companies as well as smaller generator manufacturers and mobile equipment providers, both domestic and internationally.
rows.note: 競合を製品クラスごとに実名で多数列挙（Kohler/Briggs/Cummins/Honda/Caterpillar等）し「一部の競合は値下げして低マージンを受け入れる用意がある」と価格競争も自認。qualification/switching cost の記述はゼロで、堀は販売店網とブランド。
requalif/qualif/design-in/switching/sole supplier を全走査したが、顧客側の負担も移行摩擦も一言も無い。あるのは自動車向け90%シェアと自社特許480件（自社取得なので85には当たらない）のみで、供給は『annual blanket purchase orders』＝短期。刻みを支える記述が見つからず null。

rows.quote: New tires are sold under highly competitive conditions throughout the world. On a worldwide basis, we have two major competitors: Bridgestone (based in Japan) and Michelin (based in France). Other significant competitors include Continental, Cooper, Hankook, Kumho, Pirelli, Toyo, Yokohama and various regional tire manufacturers.
rows.note: 競合10社超を実名列挙し、競争軸は『product design, performance, price and terms』＝価格を含む。qualification・switching の記述なし。

rows.quote: We operate in highly competitive geographic and product markets. Competitors include large national and international companies and numerous local and regional companies, some of which have greater resources. We compete for limited retailer shelf space for our products, and some of those retailers also market competitive products under their own private labels.
rows.note: 棚の取り合い＋小売のプライベートブランドが自社製品と競合、と会社自身が述べる典型的な代替容易型。有機/コーシャ等の認証は自社が第三者から取得する側で85に当たらない。

rows.quote: The competition is principally based on price and service to the extent that our parts are interchangeable.
rows.note: 『our parts are interchangeable』＝互換品であることを会社自身が明言し競争軸は価格。PMAはHEICOがFAAから取得する側の認可（規約の除外型）で、再認定の記述は自社サプライヤ交代時（向きが逆）にしかない。

rows.quote: Once our products have been designed into a system, the customer may be reluctant to change its component suppliers due to the significant costs and time associated with qualifying a new supplier or a replacement component.
rows.note: 設計組込＋供給者認定コストの記述はあるが『may be reluctant』の緩い形で、顧客の工程/製品の再認定の断定ではない。同じ節が『our future success depends on prospective customers designing our products into their products』『we strive to work closely with…』と願望形で締め、競争は『principally occurs at the design stage』＋ASP下落と自認するので85には届かない。

rows.quote: The sources of carbon fiber we can use in any product or application are generally dictated by customer qualifications or certifications.
rows.note: 用途ごとに使える材料源を決めるのは顧客の qualification/certification だと断定。補強として『We are currently qualified to supply materials to a broad range of over 100 helicopter, military aircraft and space programs』『the cost of product qualification makes it impractical to develop multiple sources of supply』『competitive factors include approvals, database of usage…customer preferred processes』。留保: 引用の主語はHexcelが買う炭素繊維の話で、顧客が再認定費用を負うという直接の断定文はない。

rows.quote: Our reagent rental programs provide our customers the right to use our instruments in consideration for multi-year agreements to purchase annual minimum amounts of consumables.
rows.note: 据付機器＋専用consumables＋複数年最低購入契約＋前払ロイヤルティ型のロイヤルティ計画＝深い統合と切替摩擦。ただし顧客側の再認定の記述はゼロで、逆に『Approximately half of 2014 Catalyst analyzer placements were to customers…who had been using instruments from one of our competitors』と実際に双方向の乗り換えが起きていると自認。
qualification/switching/interchangeable/sole source を走査したが、JAKAFIの代替可能性にも移行障壁にも触れる記述が無い。堀の源泉は自社特許とFDA承認＝規約が85から明示除外する自社取得型で、かつ50を支える『同等品を多数が供給』の記述も無いため null。

rows.quote: Many of our products are viewed as basic ingredients that compete with virtually identical products and derivatives manufactured by other companies in the industry.
rows.note: 『virtually identical products』を他社が製造していると会社自身が明言。競争は『largely based on price, quality and product availability』。教科書的な irr=50。

rows.quote: This is particularly true for online and mobile products and services, where the barriers to entry are lower than they are for desktop software products and services. To attract customers, many online and mobile competitors are offering free or low-priced entry-level products which we must take into account in our pricing strategies.
rows.note: 参入障壁が低くフリーミアムの価格競争にさらされる、と会社自身が述べる。switching/lock-in/データ移行コストの記述は走査しても無く、原本の言葉だけなら50。ただし全体の印象（QuickBooksが小規模事業ソフトの首位・会計士のProAdvisor網・エコシステム）は堀が強く見えるためmoat5=4。

rows.quote: The principal competitive factors in the petroleum drilling and production equipment markets are quality, reliability and reputation of the product, price, technology, service and timely delivery.
rows.note: 競争軸に価格を含み、『Several of its primary competitors are diversified multinational companies with substantially larger operating staffs and greater capital resources』と自社が小さい側だと述べる。ISO/APIの認証は自社取得側（除外型）、『qualification』の語は自社の製品評判づくりと人材の文脈のみで顧客側の再認定はゼロ。

rows.quote: We operate in a competitive environment for most of our projects, systems and products. Competition is based on product and program performance, price, reputation, reliability, life cycle costs, overall value to the customer and responsiveness to customer requirements.
rows.note: 20-F(2015-03-11)。Competition節が自ら競争入札市場と述べ、Boeing/LM/Raytheon等20社近くを名指し『Many of these competitors have greater financial, marketing and other resources than ours』。認証はISO-9001/AS9100/FAA Part145/NATO AQAPと全て当社が取得する側で、顧客側の再認定の記述はゼロ。

rows.quote: Even if we are able to develop new or improved products, our ability to market them could be limited by the need for regulatory clearance, restrictions imposed on approved indications, entrenched patterns of clinical practice, uncertainty over third-party reimbursement, or other factors.
rows.note: 『entrenched patterns of clinical practice』＝臨床慣行が既に固着しているという既成状態の記述＋『Supported by extensive customer training』の教育投資で高摩擦。ただし顧客側の再認定は無く、GPOの qualified supplier は当社が取得する側なので85は不成立。

rows.quote: Management believes that the U.S. pawn industry remains highly fragmented with an estimated 10,000 to 15,000 total pawnshops in the United States and 6,000 pawnshops in Mexico.
rows.note: 原本が明示的に highly fragmented と断定し、競合は質店・宝飾店・rent-to-own・量販・オンラインまで多数。移行障壁の記述は皆無で50が両側から確定。

rows.quote: FactSet's applications, supported by its client support and service offerings, are entrenched in the workflow of many financial professionals given the downloading functions and portfolio analysis/screening capabilities they offer. As a result, the Company's products have become central to investment analysis and decision-making for clients.
rows.note: 『are entrenched in the workflow』『have become central to』＝既に業務動線へ埋め込まれた完了状態＝深い統合。ただし顧客側の再認定・再試験の記述は無く、同節は市場を competitive とも述べるので85ではなく70。

rows.quote: Within FirstEnergy’s Regulated Distribution segment, generally there is no competition for electric distribution service in the Utilities’ respective service territories in Ohio, Pennsylvania, West Virginia, Maryland, New Jersey and New York.
rows.note: 規制フランチャイズによる唯一供給を原本が明言（送電も『traditionally been no competition』）。ただし機構は認証でなく規制。留保: CES(競争発電)は deregulated market で競争し、オハイオでは既に81%の需要が alternative suppliers＝全社では刻みが割れる。

rows.quote: The markets we serve are new, rapidly evolving and highly competitive, and we expect competition to persist and intensify in the future. Our principal competitors in the application delivery networking market include Brocade Communications Systems, Inc., Citrix Systems, Inc., Radware Ltd. and A10 Networks.
rows.note: ADC/FW/WAN最適化の各市場で代替供給者を多数名指し、ASP erosion にも言及。'switching cost' の語は全文でゼロ、sales cycle も2-3ヶ月と短く、認証は自社のパートナー認定制度のみ。

rows.quote: We support a broad range of client-owned peripheral devices manufactured by a variety of vendors, which reduces a new client’s initial conversion expenses, enhances existing clients’ ability to change technology and broadens our market opportunity.
rows.note: コア勘定系の conversion expenses の存在を原本が前提として述べ、3-5年契約・high renewal rates・non-discretionary・契約途中解約の termination fee も記載＝高摩擦。顧客側の再認定の断定は無いので85ではない。

rows.quote: Competition from generic agrochemical producers is significant as a number of key product patents held industry-wide have expired in the last decade.
rows.note: 最大セグメント(Ag Solutions)でジェネリック競争を自認。Health&Nutritionも『suppliers of other hydrocolloids, which may provide similar functionality』と代替性を明記。顧客の再処方・再認定の記述は探したが無し。

rows.quote: Although no competitor duplicates all of our products, some competitors are larger than our Company, both in terms of sales of directly competing products and in terms of total sales and financial resources. We also face competitors with different cost structures and expectations of profitability and these companies may offer competitive products at lower prices.
rows.note: 各セグメントに複数競合＋低価格競争を自認。堀は流通網とブランドで、'qualification'/'switching' の語はゼロ。顧客の工程認定・設計組込の記述なし。

rows.quote: We have numerous competitors with respect to the sale of our products, including brand owners, distributors that import products from abroad, and domestic retailers with established foreign manufacturing capabilities.
rows.note: アパレル卸・小売とも intensely competitive・deep discount pricing を自認。売上はライセンスブランド依存で、移行障壁の記述は皆無。

rows.quote: Our marketed products target a number of areas, including viral, cardiovascular, respiratory and fungal diseases. There are many commercially available products for the treatment of these diseases.
rows.note: 原本が同一疾患領域の多数の代替薬とジェネリック（HIV: BMS/GSK/ViiV、HCV: AbbVie Viekira Pak・Janssen Olysio）を列挙。排他性は当社が取得する特許＝規約上85には当たらず、顧客側の再認定も無い。

rows.quote: The spine industry is characterized by intense competition, and the spine market continues to attract numerous new companies and technologies, which has encouraged more established companies to intensify competitive pricing pressure.
rows.note: 新規参入多数＋GPO主導の価格圧力を自認。むしろ大手側の『established relationships with spine surgeons』『products supported by long-term clinical data』を自社に対する競合優位として列挙＝当社が挑戦者側。

rows.quote: The markets in the pulp, paper and packaging product lines are large and fragmented. The major markets, both U.S. and non-U.S., in which the Company sells its principal products are very competitive. Our products compete with similar products produced by other forest products companies.
rows.note: 原本が自ら fragmented・very competitive・同種品と競合と述べる＝残余刻み50が両側から確定。qualification/certified の全走査でも顧客側の認定・再認定の記述はゼロ（該当語は全てSOX証明書と訴訟のclass certification）。

rows.quote: The freight transportation markets in which we operate are frequently referred to as highly fragmented and competitive.
rows.note: 全社ベースの構造記述が明確に fragmented。DCSは3〜10年（平均約5年）の長期契約、JBIはBNSF等との独自提携・専用コンテナ/シャーシがあるが、顧客側の再認定や移行費用の断定は無い。50の側で確定。

rows.quote: All aspects of Jefferies business are intensely competitive. Jefferies competes directly with a number of bank holding companies and commercial banks, other brokers and dealers, investment banking firms and other financial institutions.
rows.note: ※原本の提出体は LEUCADIA NATIONAL CORPORATION 2014 FORM 10-K（CIK 96223）＝ティッカー写像の産物。Jefferies も National Beef も原本が自ら intensely competitive／他の食肉processorと競合と述べる。認定・移行障壁の記述なし。

rows.quote: Our contracts with our customers for outsourced data processing services generally run for a period of five or more years. Because of the rapid growth of our outsourcing business over the last five years, we will experience greater numbers of these contracts coming up for renewal over the next few years. Renewal time presents our customers with the opportunity to consider other providers or to renegotiate their contracts with us.
rows.note: 5年超契約＋データ変換・実装・訓練という深い統合で移行摩擦は明確に高いが、顧客側の再認定の断定は無い。むしろ原本自身が『converting diverse banks and credit unions to our core platforms from every competitive platform』と乗り換えが現に起きると述べる＝85には届かず70。

rows.quote: Further, use of plate and sheet in safety critical applications makes quality and product consistency critical factors. Suppliers must pass a rigorous qualification process to sell to airframe manufacturers.
rows.note: 顧客（airframe manufacturers）が運営する認定関門を事実として断定し、別箇所で『there are a limited number of suppliers worldwide who are qualified to serve these market segments』＝既に認定済みの限定名簿を述べる（2018年RBCの『qualified for the application by the OEM』と同型）。留保: 認定費用が顧客側に落ちる断定は無く、Aero/HSは全社の一部（GE/自動車は同社自身が highly competitive と述べる）。

rows.quote: The global apparel industry is highly competitive and fragmented. It is characterized by low barriers to entry, brands targeted at specific consumer segments, many regional and local competitors, and an increasing number of global competitors.
rows.note: 原本が『highly competitive and fragmented』『low barriers to entry』と構造を自認＝50が両側から確定。認定・移行障壁の記述は全走査でゼロ。

rows.quote: The market for athletic apparel is highly competitive. It includes increasing competition from established companies that are expanding their production and marketing of performance products, as well as from frequent new entrants to the market.
rows.note: 『frequent new entrants』＝参入が容易だと原本が述べる。垂直小売とブランドは差別化要因として自認するが、顧客側の移行費用・再認定は一切なし。堀の実体はブランドのみなので主観は中位。

rows.quote: Our Macao operations face intense competition, which could have a material adverse effect on our financial condition, results of operations or cash flows. The hotel, resort and casino businesses are highly competitive.
rows.note: マカオ3コンセッション+3サブ、シンガポール2ライセンスという規制の希少性は強いが、これは当社が自ら取得する免許＝85の除外類型。顧客（来訪者）側の移行障壁は原本になく、自ら highly competitive と述べる→50。moat5は免許希少性とコタイの立地を織り込んで3。

rows.quote: We believe that barriers to entry into the promotion services business are low and that certain local promoters are increasingly expanding the geographic scope of their operations.
rows.note: 最大セグメントのConcertsについて原本が自ら『barriers to entry ... are low』と述べる。Ticketingは3〜5年の排他契約（『clients may not utilize, authorize or promote the services of third-party ticketing companies』）で摩擦はあるが、契約上の排他であって顧客側の再認定ではなく、かつ全社ベースでは低障壁側の記述が支配。

rows.quote: The residential furniture industry is highly competitive and fragmented. We compete with many other manufacturers and retailers, including online retailers, some of which offer widely advertised products, and others of which are large retail furniture dealers offering their own store-branded products.
rows.note: 原本が highly competitive and fragmented と構造を自認＝50確定。qualification/certification の走査では該当語がSOX証明書のみ。

rows.quote: We establish, apply and enforce standards surrounding participation in the MasterCard payments system. We grant licenses that provide issuers and acquirers that meet specified criteria with certain rights, including access to the network and usage of cards and payment devices carrying our brands.
rows.note: 参加標準・ライセンスは当社が顧客（issuer/acquirer）を認定する側＝向きが逆で85の型ではない（新規参加者への入場要件）。四者間ネットワークへの深い接続と決済統合で移行摩擦は高いので70。反対材料も原本にある: 『Most of our customer relationships are not exclusive and in certain circumstances may be terminated by our customers』および発行体がMA/Visa双方を発行する旨の記述。

rows.quote: Business consultants, systems analysts, and technical personnel assist customers in all phases of implementing our systems, including planning and design, customer-specific module configuration, on-site implementation- or conversion from existing systems, and integration with customer systems such as Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), web- and mobile-based commerce platforms, and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) systems.
rows.note: 顧客固有の設定・既存系からの変換・ERP/MHEとの統合＝深い統合で移行摩擦は高いが、顧客側の再認定の断定は無い。原本自身は市場を『intensely competitive』とし、Oracle/SAP/Infor/JDA等を名指し。よって70止まり。

rows.quote: MA's integrated risk management software platform embeds Moody's solutions deep into the technology infrastructure of banks and insurance companies worldwide.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。深い統合の断定はあるがMA限定で、顧客側の再認定の記述はゼロ。NRSRO登録は当社が取得する側の地位ゆえ85に当たらない（発行体が他CRAへ替えても投資家に再認定費用は落ちない）。COMPETITION節はS&P/Fitch他多数を名指しし『Many users of MIS's ratings also have in-house credit research capabilities』とも述べる。

rows.quote: Barriers-to-entry for large, established Internet companies are relatively low, and current and new competitors can launch new sites at relatively low cost using commercially available software.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K Competition節が参入容易を自認。リスク要因でも『Barriers to entry are relatively low ... can easily launch new sites』と重ねる。認定・移行障壁の記述は全文に無い。

rows.quote: Our pulp is considered a commodity because many companies produce similar and largely standardized products. As a result, the primary basis for competition in our markets has been price.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。原本自ら標準化商品・価格競争と述べる。唯一の認証言及はFSC/PEFC等の森林認証で、当社が取得する側（かつ『不適合なら顧客に売れなくなる』＝当社側の負担）。

rows.quote: The homebuilding industry is fragmented and highly competitive.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K Competition節。競争基準は『price, location, design, quality, service, and reputation』で、移行障壁・認定の記述は皆無。

rows.quote: There are a number of competitors in the spices, herbs and seasoning category, many with less than 3% share of sales. More than 250 other brands of spices, herbs and seasonings are sold in the U.S. with additional brands in international markets.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。消費者側は多数ブランドが供給。産業用も『we strive to achieve customer intimacy』＝願望形で顧客側の再処方・再認定の断定なし。『Each segment operates in markets around the world that are highly competitive』。ブランドとしての堀は強いがirrの刻みでは50。

rows.quote: Our products compete across several industries with a variety of companies, many of which are well established, with substantially greater capital resources and larger research and development capabilities.
rows.note: FY2015/3期 10-K。各部門ごとに競合を多数名指し（3M/Steris/Danaher/Thermo等）。『We prefer markets that have limited competition』は戦略の願望。ISO13485等の認証は当社が取得する側で、顧客側の再バリデーションを要する記述は探したが無い。

rows.quote: Despite recent consolidation, the commercial real estate services industry remains highly fragmented and competitive.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。『high barriers to entry』の記述はあるが営業人員の構築という一般論で顧客側の負担ではない（規約の除外例）。同じ10-Kが自市場をfragmentedと繰り返す。

rows.quote: The competitive environment has changed dramatically over the past few years as our traditional OEM customers, faced with intense international competition, have expanded their sourcing of components. As a result, we have experienced competition from suppliers in other parts of the world that enjoy economic advantages, such as lower labor costs, lower health care costs, lower tax rates, lower costs associated with legal compliance, and, in some cases, export or raw materials subsidies.
rows.note: FY2015/3期 10-K。設計・治具費用の負担はあるが方向が逆（当社がOEMの費用を吸収）。低コスト地域への切替が現に起きていると自認。顧客側の再認定の記述なし。

rows.quote: We believe our products and tools are deeply embedded in many portions of financial advisors' daily workflow.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。深い統合の断定＝70。ただし同じ原本が『lower technology costs and the growth of open software platforms have lowered the barriers to entry for new competitors』と述べ、主要製品ごとにBloomberg/FactSet/Thomson Reuters等を名指し。顧客側の再認定は皆無なので85には届かない。

rows.quote: The personals business is very competitive and highly fragmented and barriers to entry are minimal.
rows.note: 原本はIAC/InterActiveCorpのFY2014 10-K（CIK 891103）＝当時Match Groupは独立の提出体ではなくMatchはIACのセグメント。そのMatch(Personals)節が自らfragmented・参入障壁最小と述べる。

rows.quote: Many of our customers require a thorough review or qualification of semiconductor products, which may take several months.
rows.note: FY2014/8期 10-K。顧客側の製品認定に数ヶ月という長期認定期間の断定はあるが『再認定をやり直す費用』の記述は無く、同じ原本が『DDR3 DRAM is a standardized, high-density, high-volume, DRAM product』とASP年−45%級の下落を示す＝標準化商品。よって85ではなく70。逆向きの記述『customers may elect to disqualify us as a supplier』もある。

rows.quote: For example, following our Supreme Court case discussed in Item 3, Legal Proceedings, a number of companies commenced offering certain clinical diagnostic testing for hereditary breast and ovarian cancer that compete with our BRACAnalysis testing and future molecular diagnostic testing we plan to launch.
rows.note: FY2014/6期 10-K。原本自身が代替の実際の出現を記述。CLIA認証は当社が取得する側で85の除外型。価格侵食（CMSの減額）も自認。

rows.quote: Each of the wealth management market, asset management market and internet finance industry in China is at a relatively early stage of development and is fragmented and highly competitive, and we expect competition to persist and intensify.
rows.note: 20-F(2015-04-24)。原本自身が市場を fragmented かつ highly competitive と述べる＝残余刻み50。qualification の語は全てPRC当局が当社に課す免許要件（自社取得側）で顧客の再認定ではない。

rows.quote: The oilfield products and services industry is highly competitive. We compete with national, regional and foreign competitors in each of our current major product lines.
rows.note: 10-K(2015-02-17)。installed base が Rig Aftermarket の需要源だが、原本は同事業を『sold in highly competitive markets…affected by competitive actions such as price changes』と自認。re-certification は顧客の掘削リグ側の法定再検査で当社製品の認定ではない。

rows.quote: Our market is fragmented and competitive, with many competitors providing various forms of site preparation products and services.
rows.note: readlist の原本は CIK 71829＝Newpark Resources の10-K(2015-02-27)＝ティッカー表記と社名の突合せは要確認。Mats部門を fragmented と自認し、Fluids部門も『Schlumberger, Halliburton and Baker Hughes, which compete vigorously on fluids performance and/or price』＝50。

rows.quote: There are relatively few barriers to entry into the Company's market, and the Company expects increased competition in its market which could adversely affect the Company's operating results through pricing pressure, increased marketing expenditures, and market share losses, among other factors.
rows.note: 10-K(2015-03-04)。会社自身が参入障壁の低さと価格圧力を明言＝50。顧客側の再認定・切替コストの記述は走査で一件も無し。

rows.quote: The service assurance and performance management market is highly competitive, rapidly evolving, and fragmented with overlapping technologies and a wide range of competitors.
rows.note: 10-K(2015-05-20)。fragmented と明言＝50。certification のヒットは自社取得のISO 9001とSOX証明のみ、sole/single source は当社の部品調達側（向きが逆）。

rows.quote: The Company competes with numerous other manufacturers and distributors of consumer and commercial products, many of which are large and well-established.
rows.note: 10-K(2015-03-02)。原本は大型小売の交渉力と『fostering high levels of competition among suppliers, requiring suppliers to maintain or reduce product prices』を自認＝50。single source は当社の仕入先依存（向きが逆）。

rows.quote: Our print and digital products compete for advertising and consumers with other media in their respective markets, including paid and free newspapers, digital media, broadcast, satellite and cable television, broadcast and satellite radio, magazines, other forms of media and direct marketing.
rows.note: 10-K(2015-02-24)。広告・読者とも多数の代替媒体と競合すると自認＝50。認証・移行障壁の記述は皆無（ヒットはSOX証明と年金の actuary certification のみ）。

rows.quote: There are approximately ten manufacturers of flexible metal hose in the United States, and approximately that number in Europe and Asia.
rows.note: 10-K(2015-03-13)。同等品を約10社が供給できると原本が数で述べる＝50。UL971A等の certification は当社が自分で取得する側で規約の85に当たらない。

rows.quote: Our manufacturing operations and products are certified ISO 9001, ISO 14001, American Society of Mechanical Engineers, and TÜV, and we are an approved supplier to many electric utilities around the world.
rows.note: 10-K(2015-02-26)。電力会社の承認供給者名簿に載っている旨の完了形の断定＋『Once we or other developers obtained such rights or own a power plant, competition is limited』。ただし列挙された認証はISO/ASME/TÜV＝自社取得側で、顧客が別供給者を再認定する費用の記述は無いため85には届かず70。『high barriers to entry』の一般論は規約により不採用。

rows.quote: The sale of automotive aftermarket items is highly competitive in many areas, including customer service, product availability, store location, brand recognition and price.
rows.note: 10-K(2015-02-27)。価格を含む多面的な競争と自認＝50。certified by ASE は自社の店員が取得する資格で顧客側の再認定ではない。店舗網の密度は主観的には強い堀に見えるので moat5=4 と irr=50 を独立に付けた。

rows.quote: The market for payroll processing and human resource services is highly competitive and fragmented.
rows.note: 10-K(2014-07-22・FY2014)。fragmented と明言し、さらに『service agreements…generally terminable by the client at any time or upon relatively short notice』・client retention 約82%＝解約は現に起きる＝50。認証・再認定の記述は皆無。

rows.quote: Our beverage, food and snack products are in highly competitive industries and markets and compete against products of international beverage, food and snack companies that, like us, operate in multiple geographies, as well as regional, local and private label manufacturers and other value competitors.
rows.note: 10-K(2015-02-12)。プライベートブランドを含む多数の代替供給者を自ら列挙＝50。移行障壁の記述は無く、むしろ上位5小売で北米売上31%（Wal-Mart 18%）と顧客側の交渉力を開示。

rows.quote: We face competition from a variety of companies and the markets for our services are fragmented and competitive. Our competitors include national managed care providers, preferred provider networks, smaller independent providers and insurance companies.
rows.note: California workers' comp HCO/MPN管理。原本が自ら市場をfragmentedと述べ、顧客側の再認定の記述は皆無。HCOライセンスは当社が自分で取得する側（州発行・9件中2件を保有）＝85の対象外。

rows.quote: The off-road vehicle, snowmobile, motorcycle and small vehicle markets in the United States, Canada and other global markets are highly competitive. Competition in such markets is based upon a number of factors, including price, quality, reliability, styling, product features and warranties.
rows.note: 消費者向け車両。競争基準が価格・品質・スタイリングで、顧客側の認定・移行費用の記述は無い。ISMA/CARB等の認証は当社が満たす側。

rows.quote: The children's apparel, footwear and accessories retail markets are highly competitive. Our primary competitors are specialty stores and mass merchandisers including Target Corporation, GapKids, babyGap and Old Navy
rows.note: 小売。原本が highly competitive と競合を名指しし、顧客の乗り換え障壁の記述は無い。品質認証は当社の対サプライヤ検査で向きが逆。

rows.quote: In either case, typically, invited purchasers will have already successfully completed a qualification process that can include the owner's reviews of any or all of the following: the purchaser’s experience, reputation, financial standing, operating procedures, business practices, and compliance oversight.
rows.note: 債権売主が購入者を事前に審査済み＝認定業者名簿型で、原本も「significant barriers to successful entry for new competitors」と述べる。ただし認定済み業者間で「We face bidding competition in our acquisition of defaulted finance receivables」＝入札競争が続き、売主が当社に固着する断定は無いので85ではなく70。

rows.quote: We believe that price competition for drilling and pressure pumping contracts will continue to be intense due to the existence of available rigs and pressure pumping equipment.
rows.note: 陸上掘削・圧入。原本自身が装置の余剰と設備の市場間移動が競争を激化させると述べる。認定・移行障壁の記述を探したが皆無。

rows.quote: The printing industry, with approximately 48,000 companies in the United States, is highly fragmented and competitive. The five largest printing companies account for approximately 20% of total commercial print industry annual revenue in the United States
rows.note: 商業印刷。原本が業界を highly fragmented と明示し、価格・品質・納期での競争と過剰能力による下落圧力を自認。qualification語は401(k)の税法用語のみで堀とは無関係。

rows.quote: The market for outpatient diagnostic imaging services is highly competitive. We compete locally for patients with groups of radiologists, established hospitals, clinics and other independent organizations that own and operate imaging equipment.
rows.note: 外来画像診断。MQSA認定・州免許はいずれも当社が取得する側。『provides barriers to entry by competitors in our markets』は自社の一般論で顧客側の負担が書かれておらず、規約により証拠にならない。

rows.quote: Competition among product candidates approved for sale is based on efficacy, safety, reliability, availability, price, patent position, and other factors.
rows.note: バイオ医薬。堀の源泉は自社特許・規制上の市場独占期間＝規約が明示除外する型。原本はEYLEAの競合表を載せ、網膜専門医がLucentis/Avastinから乗り換える（逆も然り）と述べる＝代替は現に起きる。

rows.quote: We operate in a competitive, fragmented market, and we compete for clients and consultants with a variety of organizations that offer similar services. The competition is likely to increase in the future due to the expected growth of the market and the relatively few barriers to entry.
rows.note: 専門人材コンサル。原本が『relatively few barriers to entry』と自認する最も明快な50。policyIQは自社ツールだが顧客の再認定の記述は無い。

rows.quote: There are a large number of investment castings and MIM manufacturers, both domestic and foreign, with which the Company competes.
rows.note: 銃器＋鋳造。銃器側も『Competition in the firearms industry is intense』で競争手段は製品革新・品質・入手性・価格。鋳造側は多数供給者を明記＝代替容易。顧客側認定の記述を探したが無い。

rows.quote: We cannot assure you that physicians will continue to prescribe our products, or that home healthcare dealers or patients will not substitute competing products when a prescription specifying our products has been written.
rows.note: 処方指定が書かれた後ですら代替されうる、と原本が自ら述べる＝移行障壁の不在の直接証拠。堀の記述は自社の859件の米国特許＝規約が除外する自社取得型。流通（HD дилер・睡眠クリニック）も『most of whom use, sell or recommend several brands』。

rows.quote: Our dealership agreements are non-exclusive and have relatively short terms which could result in non-renewal or imposition of less favorable terms upon renewal. Our dealership agreements generally do not provide us with exclusive dealerships in any territory.
rows.note: 商用車ディーラー。OEM（Peterbilt/Navistar）からの認定は当社が受ける側で、しかも非独占・短期・チェンジオブコントロールで解除可。顧客側の再認定の記述は無く、原本も『significant competition』を認める。

rows.quote: Our brands compete with competitor beer brands and other alcohol beverages, including wine and spirits, and thus our competitive position is affected by consumer preferences among these other categories.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。既定の堀パターンで requalif/qualification/designed in の該当ゼロ。米国は「highly competitive」、カナダは二大醸造所、加えてワイン・スピリッツへ消費者が乗り換える構造を自ら述べる＝代替容易側。ブランドと流通規模は強いが顧客側の再認定は皆無。

rows.quote: Since each of these wireless competitors operates on systems using spectrum licensed by the FCC and has comparable technology and facilities, competition among wireless service providers for customers is principally on the basis of types of products and services, price, size of area covered, call quality, network speed and responsiveness of customer service.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。競合が『comparable technology and facilities』を持ち価格中心の競争と明記。churn の記述はあるがバンドルで下げる努力の話で顧客側の再認定は無い。有線側も無線・ケーブルによる代替を自認。

rows.quote: The property and casualty industry is a very competitive market. Our competitors include national, international, regional and local companies that sell insurance through various distribution channels, including independent agencies, captive agency forces, brokers and direct to consumers through the internet or otherwise.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。certification のヒットは全てSOX証明書とテロ保険の財務長官認定＝当社の堀と無関係。独立代理店経由で product・price・agency で競う保険で、顧客側の再認定に相当する記述なし。

rows.quote: The agricultural and construction equipment sales and distribution industries are highly competitive and fragmented, with large numbers of companies operating on a regional or local scale.
rows.note: FY2015(1月期)10-K。原本が自ら『highly competitive and fragmented』と市場構造を述べ、競争要因は price, value, reputation, quality と列挙＝50の残余刻みが両側から確定。CNH系ディーラー権は当社側の権利で顧客の移行障壁ではない。

rows.quote: We face aggressive competition in all geographic markets and each industry sector in which we operate. In addition to price, we face competition in product performance and technological innovation, quality, reliability of delivery, customer service, and other factors.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。唯一の re-qualify は『our products were found to be not in compliance ... we could be required to re-qualify our products』＝**当社が自分で取り直す**側で、しかも同文が『replace products in use or installed with other products manufactured by ... our competitors』と代替可能性を明言。FHWA の Federal-aid 適格認定・AAR 規格も当社が取得する規制適合（政府調達資格型）で除外。

rows.quote: Our products and services are sold in highly competitive markets throughout the world. Due to the diversity of these products and services and the variety of markets served, we encounter a wide variety of competitors that vary by product line and services. The principal methods of competition in these markets relate to price, quality, delivery, service and support, technology and innovation.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K(Ingersoll-Rand plc)。競争手段が price/quality/delivery と明記。Trane・Thermo King のブランドと installed base によるサービス・部品収入は述べるが、顧客側の再認定・設計組込ロックの記述は無い。

rows.quote: both the online and mobile games marketplaces are characterized by frequent product introductions, relatively low barriers to entry, and new and evolving business methods, technologies and platforms for development
rows.note: FY2015(3月期)10-K。会社自身が『relatively low barriers to entry』と述べ、競争は innovation・brand name recognition・shelf space・price。ヒット依存も自認。フランチャイズIPは強いが原本の言葉は代替容易側。

rows.quote: New competitors are also entering our markets as barriers to entry for new competitors are relatively low.
rows.note: FY2014(8月期)10-K。参入障壁が低いと自認し、最大の競争は顧客の直接仕入(direct distribution)＝顧客が当社を外す経路が明示。QAIのオーガニック認証は当社が取得する側で除外。

rows.quote: The North American equipment rental industry is highly fragmented and competitive. As the largest equipment rental company in the industry, we estimate that we have an approximate 12 percent market share based on 2014 equipment rental revenues from construction
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。『highly fragmented and competitive』＋自社シェア約12%と数値で述べる＝50が両側から確定。規模・全国網は強みだが顧客の再認定に相当する記述は皆無。

rows.quote: For the treatment of PAH, we compete with many approved products in the United States and the rest of the world
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。堀の実体は特許・希少疾病独占・FDA承認＝いずれも**当社が取得する側**で85の除外型。原本はむしろ Flolan→Remodulin の『rapid switch protocol』、Ventavis→Tyvaso の切替試験と**乗り換えの容易さ**を宣伝し、Remodulin へのANDA提出も開示。堀の主観は強いがirrの機構は無い。

rows.quote: Competition among leaf tobacco suppliers is based on the ability to meet customer specifications in the growing, buying, processing, and financing of tobacco, and on the price charged for products and services.
rows.note: FY2015(3月期)10-K。競争は顧客仕様への適合力と価格。加えて顧客(タバコメーカー)自身が農家から直接調達して当社と競合すると明記＝代替経路が顧客の内部にある。

rows.quote: Numerous other organizations, including large, diversified firms, have greater financial resources and larger technical staffs that are capable of providing the same services offered by us.
rows.note: FY2014 10-K。『capable of providing the same services』と同等供給者の存在を自認、政府調達は競争入札が原則で『sole source ではなく competitive basis』と明記。GSAスケジュール契約は当社が取得する調達資格＝除外型。

rows.quote: Although there has been some tightening of capacity and some industry consolidation, shippers continue to have a wide range of choices.
rows.note: 荷主が広い選択肢を持つと原本が明言。『barriers to entry』の言及はサービス範囲拡大に伴う設備投資の話で顧客側の負担ではない。移行障壁の記述ゼロ→50。

rows.quote: New Platform clients undergo a business transformation process that includes either a conversion of existing client assets, or a business transition process which funds new client assets onto the Platform as the client grows their business with a contractual minimum fee in place.
rows.note: 資産の全面移行を伴う業務変革＋初期5〜7年契約＝深い統合とスイッチングコスト。ただし顧客側の再認定・データ再生成の断定は無く、自社は『in-house』解も競合と認める→70。

rows.quote: The retail footwear industry is highly competitive with few barriers to entry.
rows.note: 原本自身が『few barriers to entry』と明記。供給者の長期契約も無い（『we do not have any long-term contracts with our suppliers』）→50。

rows.quote: We experience competition from many local, regional, national and international competitors of various sizes in the manufacture, distribution and sale of our paint, coatings and related products.
rows.note: 多数の競合が同種製品を供給し、競争要因は品質・価格・サービスと原本が列挙。仕様指定・顧客側認定の記述は走査しても皆無→50（堀の実体は4,003店の直営店網＝irrの領分ではない）。

rows.quote: We face competition from a large number of competitors in each of our target markets.
rows.note: 競合を多数名指し＋『intense price competition』＋顧客自身が内製で置換しうると自認。qualifyは自社が下請/ファウンドリを認定する側（向きが逆）、FAEは『assist customers in designing, testing and qualifying』の願望形→50。

rows.quote: The packaging industry is highly competitive. We compete in this industry with manufacturers of similar and other types of packaging, as well as fillers, food processors and packers who manufacture containers for their own use and for sale to others.
rows.note: 90%が複数年供給契約・専用金型という摩擦はあるが、原本は『compete primarily on the basis of price, quality and service』と述べ顧客の自家製造も代替と明記。顧客側の再認定の記述なし→50。

rows.quote: Although competitive products exist, both new licenses and license renewals for GastroPlus have continued to grow in spite of this competition.
rows.note: GastroPlusは製薬各社とFDA・NIH等の規制当局で最も広く使われ、ライセンス更新率92%と原本が記す＝規制ワークフローへの深い定着。ただし顧客側の再認定・データ再生成の断定は無く、ADMET系は『more competitive environment』と自認→70。

rows.quote: The retail industry is dynamic and competitive. We compete with numerous merchandise distribution channels including malls, outlet centers, community/lifestyle centers, and other shopping centers in the United States and abroad.
rows.note: テナント誘致で多数の代替チャネルと競合し『The existence of competitive alternatives could have a material adverse effect on our ability to lease space』と自認。移行障壁の記述なし→50。

rows.quote: The Missouri Utility is the only distributor of natural gas within its franchised service areas, while the Alabama Utility is the main distributor of natural gas in its service areas.
rows.note: フランチャイズ区域内でガス配給の供給者が他に存在しないと原本が断定＝100の文型。留保: アラバマ側は『main』止まり、かつ同段落が電力・燃料油等の燃料間競合と大口顧客のパイプライン直結バイパスの risk を挙げる。機構は法的専属供給区域で認定型ではない。

rows.quote: Historically, the construction business has not typically required large amounts of capital for smaller contracts, which can result in relative ease of market entry for companies possessing acceptable qualifications.
rows.note: 原本自身が参入容易と明記、最低価格入札が主。prequalificationは当社が発注官庁に対して取得する側の資格（州DOTの年次審査）で、顧客側の再認定ではない→50。

rows.quote: We operate in intensely competitive markets that are characterized by competition from major domestic and international companies.
rows.note: 消費者・法執行機関とも他ブランドへ自由に移れる。走査しても顧客側の認定・承認名簿の記述なし（『approved』は自社ESPPの株主承認のみ）。上位5卸で売上34.3%＝むしろ流通依存→50。

rows.quote: we rely on OEMs and ODMs of wireless communications electronics products to select our products from among alternative offerings to be designed into their equipment. Without these “design wins,” we would have difficulty selling our products.
rows.note: 設計組込（design win）と、他社が組み込まれると次も取りにくいという粘着は明記。ただし『select our products from among alternative offerings』＝設計段階では代替可能、顧客の再認定の断定は無く、依存を語る願望形→70。

rows.quote: We operate in the intensely competitive information technology industry. This industry is characterized by rapidly changing technology, evolving industry standards, frequent new product introductions, price and cost reductions, and increasingly greater commoditization of products, making differentiation difficult. Our competitors include other large companies in the information technology industry, such as: IBM, Hewlett-Packard, Diebold, Wincor, Hyosung, ToshibaTec, Micros, Fujitsu and Unisys
rows.note: NCR。全セグメントで競合を実名列挙し、競争軸は total cost of ownership・品質・価格。会社自身が『commoditization of products, making differentiation difficult』と述べる。requalification・switching cost の記述は全文走査で0件（single source は当社の仕入れ側＝向きが逆）。

rows.quote: These entities typically govern equipment and safety standards for freight rail and passenger transit rolling stock, oversee a wide variety of rules and regulations governing safety and design of equipment, and evaluate certification and qualification requirements for suppliers. New products generally must undergo testing and approval processes that are rigorous and lengthy. As a result of these regulations and requirements, we must usually obtain and maintain certifications in a variety of jurisdictions and countries.
rows.note: FRA/AAR/UIC等による供給者の認証・新製品の rigorous and lengthy な承認＝長い評価期間はあるが、認証を取得するのは当社側で『顧客が再認定をやり直す』断定は無い（85の除外要件そのもの）。北米ブレーキ約50%シェア・売上61%がアフターマーケットだが、10-Kは『Price competition is strong』とも自認。

rows.quote: Retail electric customers in Wisconsin currently do not have the ability to choose their electric supplier. It is uncertain when, if ever, retail access might be implemented in Wisconsin.
rows.note: 規制下の独占フランチャイズ（indeterminate permits / CPCNs で territory が指定）。顧客に代替供給者が法的に存在しないと原本が明言＝『唯一供給』の刻みに該当。留保: ミシガンは retail choice 有り、ガス商品部分と卸は競争ありと同10-Kが述べる。認証機構ではないので mech は なし。

rows.quote: Our proprietary closed-loop network is a significant barrier to entry because a competitor would need to establish a direct relationship with each of the merchants that comprise the network in order to create a similar network.
rows.note: クローズドループ網（米豪で給油拠点90%超をカバー）と『U.S. fleet retention rate in excess of 98 percent』＝深い統合・高摩擦。ただし障壁は競合側の参入コストの話で顧客側の再認定の記述は無い。リスク要因では『we have been forced to respond to competitive pressures by reducing our fees』と手数料浸食を自認。

rows.quote: The domestic and international markets for water quality, conservation, safety and control devices are intensely competitive and require us to compete against some companies possessing greater financial, marketing and other resources than ours. Due to the breadth of our product offerings, the number and identities of our competitors vary by product line and market. We consider quality, brand preference, delivery times, engineering specifications, plumbing code requirements, price, technological expertise and breadth of product offerings to be the primary competitive factors.
rows.note: 認証（ASME/UL/NSF、ISO9000等）は当社が取得する側＝85の除外要件。10-Kは自ら intensely competitive と述べ、価格を競争因子に挙げ、特許依存も否定（not dependent on any one of our patents）。顧客側の再認定・スイッチングコストの記述は無い。

rows.quote: The transportation logistics industry is intensely competitive with thousands of transportation companies competing in the domestic and international markets. Our competitors include local, regional, national and international companies with the same services that our business units provide. Due in part to the fragmented nature of the industry, our business units do not operate from a position of dominance, and therefore must strive daily to retain existing business relationships and forge new relationships.
rows.note: 原本自身が『thousands of transportation companies』『fragmented』『do not operate from a position of dominance』と明言＝50の残余刻みが両側から確定。qualification 系の記述は全文で0件（certification のヒットは独立契約者の class certification と SOX 証明のみ）。

rows.quote: Specifically, it has been our experience that, once an engineer, contractor, builder or architect has specified our product with satisfactory results, that person often will continue to use our products in future projects.
rows.note: Rexnord。製品が『specified』されて OEM 製品・工事仕様に組み込まれ、摩耗交換は like-for-like（P&MC の48%がアフターマーケット、premium pricing を主張）＝設計組込・スイッチング摩擦。ただし『顧客が再認定をやり直す』断定は無く、Water Management 側は自ら relatively fragmented と述べ、流通業者はほぼ全社が競合品も扱うと自認。
